title: {{eli}}'s agent reads a PR and posts a review comment
goal: {{eli}} asks {{agent}} to read a pull request in grid-ops-portal and leave a review comment. {{vocab.mockNote}}
obstacle: An agent with a GitHub token can do anything the token can: comment, approve, even merge. {{eli}} wants the review help without the rest.
control: Cedar permits github.read_pr and github.post_review_comment for the engineers group, and nothing else on GitHub. Each call names the user (token sub), the agent (act) and the tool.
say: The agent reviews code for {{eli}}. It cannot approve or merge it, because policy never offers those tools to anyone.

steps.title: Sign in as {{eli}}
steps.tell: Pick {{eli}} on the sign-in page. The shell shows the group engineers. 'Pull Request Review' is treated as these engineering review rules (read-only, no merge, no approve) until it is clarified.
steps.say: This is {{eli}}'s token. The delivery agent will act on it, never beyond it.
steps.why: Policy reads the group from the token, not from anything the agent says.

steps.title: Read the PR
steps.tell: In the Tool console pick github.read_pr (repo grid-ops-portal, pr 42) and call. The card says allow by u10-engineers-pr-review, with a mock result labelled MOCK.
steps.say: A read goes through, and the card names the rule that said yes.
steps.why: An allow is as explainable as a deny. The backend is a mock, so the result is labelled.

steps.title: Post a review comment
steps.tell: Pick github.post_review_comment with a short body and call. Allow, same policy, still a mock.
steps.say: It can comment on the pull request. That is the whole write it gets.
steps.why: The only GitHub write in the pack is a review comment.

steps.title: See who did it
steps.tell: Open Trace. The policy, pep and tool rows each show the user (eli), the agent (delivery-agent) and the tool (github.post_review_comment).
steps.say: Every decision records the person, the agent acting for them, and the tool.
steps.why: Attribution comes from the token's sub and act claims, so an agent cannot hide behind the user or the other way round.

blocked.tell: Open Trace and find a denied call (try github.merge_pr first). The pep row still names eli, delivery-agent and the tool, with the deny and the rule.
blocked.say: A refusal is recorded with the same attribution as a success.

proof.happy: The result cards for github.read_pr and github.post_review_comment: allow, u10-engineers-pr-review, result marked mock; and the Trace rows naming eli, delivery-agent and the tool.
proof.blocked: The Trace row for a denied github.merge_pr: deny, u20-never-merge-or-approve-pr, user eli, agent delivery-agent.
